_about: Wiki-themed port of the pragmatic_segmenter English Golden Rules (52 sentence-boundary edge cases). Each case keeps the ORIGINAL rule's mechanism but uses Wikipedia/Wikidata/Wikifunctions/Wikimedia content, leaning on Wikipedia vandalism & anti-vandalism lore (Willy on Wheels' page-move vandalism and 'on Wheels!' suffix, ClueBot NG, reverting, blanking, AIV, recent-changes patrol). Real named community members are avoided (Denny Vrandečić is an allowed exception); names required by a rule's mechanism use generic placeholders (Dr. Lee, Mr. Ito) or non-community article subjects (Ursula K. Le Guin, Michael I. Jordan). Sources: pragmatic_segmenter Golden Rules (https://github.com/diasks2/pragmatic_segmenter), PySBD (https://aclanthology.org/2020.nlposs-1.15/), Vandalism on Wikipedia (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vandalism_on_Wikipedia). Target function: Z18522 'segment sentences' (text: Z6) -> List(Z6). Expected arrays follow pragmatic_segmenter conventions (sentences trimmed; errant newlines handled per rules 40-42).

on_wiki.testers: Z37557..Z37608 — the tester for rule n is Z(37556+n)
